How Our Lab Uses the Goettfert Capillary Rheometer 
The Göttfert Rheotester 1000 and Rheograph 2003 are high-pressure capillary rheometers. These instruments are used to determine the flow characteristics and viscosities of thermoplastic polymers and rubbers. 
Common Applications 
viscosity-shear rate data 
extensional viscosity measurement (Cogswell or Moldflow scheme) 
first normal stress difference (Gleissle scheme) 
Bagley end-pressure loss correction 
thermal stability 
Mooney slip 
slit die measurements 
Operating Ranges Offered 
 Operating ranges for Goettfert Capillary Rheometer 
Pressure 
1 bar to 1000 bar 
Shear rate 
0.1 to 175,000 /sec 
Temperature 
25 to 500°C

Get Started 
 Share your requirements 
Tell us about the material, application, environment, and any method, standard, specimen, or conditioning constraints. 
 Confirm the approach 
We’ll align the appropriate method, specimen requirements, and deliverables to your objectives, then provide a quote and test plan. 
 Submit your PO and materials 
Send the purchase order and arrange delivery of materials or specimens so the program can move into scheduling and execution. 
 Receive your results 
You’ll receive an engineering test report with digital data delivery, along with any agreed raw data or method-appropriate outputs. 
Typical turnaround for most testing is five business days. Longer-duration programs may require more time.
